name: Prospect.io (now Overloop)
description_en:
The original prospect.io address redirects to Overloop. Overloop’s own About page says the product began in 2015 as a Chrome extension called Prospect.io. This profile therefore describes the current successor with that identity evidence, rather than presenting old Prospect.io prices as current. The current product combines prospect discovery, AI-assisted content and email/LinkedIn outreach.

The outreach page describes messages, delays and conditions, including routing contacts with an email address differently from those without one. Enrollment is gradual and depends on sending capacity and connected accounts. A proposed pilot should verify addresses, review a message sample, then enroll a small approved audience. Supported CRM workflows vary; the official page explicitly says prospect replies cannot sync from Overloop into HubSpot. Do not promise full bidirectional conversation sync.
description_zh:
原 prospect.io 地址跳转至 Overloop。Overloop 自己的 About 页面说明产品于 2015 年从名为 Prospect.io 的 Chrome 扩展起步。因此本档案在身份依据下介绍当前后继产品，不把旧 Prospect.io 价格当作现价。当前产品组合线索发现、AI 辅助内容与邮件／LinkedIn 触达。

触达页描述消息、延迟与条件，包括让有邮箱和无邮箱的联系人走不同分支。入序是渐进的，取决于发送容量与已连接账户。建议试点先验证地址、审查消息样本，再加入少量经授权受众。CRM 支持范围因集成而异；官方页面明确说明线索回复无法从 Overloop 同步到 HubSpot，不能承诺完整双向会话同步。

core_features.explanation_en: Branch between email and LinkedIn according to contact data and behavior.
core_features.explanation_zh: 按联系数据与行为在邮件和 LinkedIn 间分支。

core_features.explanation_en: Prevent creation or contact for excluded emails and domains.
core_features.explanation_zh: 阻止对排除邮箱与域名创建线索或触达。

en: Preview a conditional email and LinkedIn sequence
zh: 预览邮件与 LinkedIn 条件序列
use_cases.basis: Illustrative evaluation workflow; not an executed test or customer result.

Evaluation scope.en: Official public documentation research. Account setup, integrations and delivery were not executed.
Evaluation scope.zh: 研究官方公开资料；未实际注册、运行集成或验证交付。

steps.en: The outreach page describes messages, delays and conditions, including routing contacts with an email address differently from those without one. Enrollment is gradual and depends on sending capacity and connected accounts. A proposed pilot should verify addresses, review a message sample, then enroll a small approved audience. Supported CRM workflows vary; the official page explicitly says prospect replies cannot sync from Overloop into HubSpot. Do not promise full bidirectional conversation sync.
steps.zh: 触达页描述消息、延迟与条件，包括让有邮箱和无邮箱的联系人走不同分支。入序是渐进的，取决于发送容量与已连接账户。建议试点先验证地址、审查消息样本，再加入少量经授权受众。CRM 支持范围因集成而异；官方页面明确说明线索回复无法从 Overloop 同步到 HubSpot，不能承诺完整双向会话同步。

items.en: A team wanting data and multichannel follow-up together can shortlist Overloop; one requiring HubSpot reply synchronization should validate an alternative handoff. Exclusion lists, bounce/out-of-office tracking and reply logging are documented, but no recovery workflow was executed here. Check recipient state and channel capacity before re-enrolling. The current service is hosted online; source licensing and customer-operated deployment were not confirmed. No alternative relationship has been approved by this research.
items.zh: 需要统一数据与多渠道跟进的团队可考虑 Overloop；要求 HubSpot 回复同步的团队应验证其他交接方式。文档记录排除名单、退信／自动回复跟踪与回复日志，但本次未实际运行恢复流程。重新入序前应检查收件人状态与渠道容量。当前为托管在线服务，未确认源代码许可与客户自营部署；本次研究没有批准替代关系。

pricing.source_snapshot_en: Current pricing lists Starter $69/user/month with 250 credits, one email account and three campaigns; Growth $99 with 500 credits, three email accounts and ten campaigns. Enterprise is custom with higher limits and Salesforce integration. A seven-day trial is advertised, separate from paid use; no continuing free tier was established. Confirm billing term, additional credits and account limits in the purchase flow. The old directory snapshot is not a current quote.
pricing.source_snapshot_zh: 当前定价列 Starter 每用户每月 69 美元，含 250 额度、一个邮箱与三场活动；Growth 为 99 美元，含 500 额度、三个邮箱与十场活动。Enterprise 定制报价，提供较高限额与 Salesforce 集成。页面宣传七天试用，与付费使用不同，未证实长期免费层。采购时应核对账期、额外额度与账户限制，旧目录快照不是现行报价。
